sloka: ऊचुः सुरासुराः सर्वे तदा विग्रहमागताः ।प्रेक्षमाणा महद्युद्धं वाक्यं भक्त्या प्रहृष्टवत् ।। ६.१०४.७ ।।
transliteration: ūcuḥ surāsurāḥ sarve tadā vigrahamāgatāḥ ।prekṣamāṇā mahadyuddhaṁ vākyaṁ bhaktyā prahṛṣṭavat ।। 6.104.7 ।।

translations.english: Then watching the great war, all the Suras, Asuras, lost control and overcome with happiness spoke these words with devotion.
